author: Joseph Conrad
title: Heart of Darkness, in Youth: a Narrative, and Two Other Stories
edition: Edinburgh and London: William Blackwood and Sons, 1902. Scan-backed Wikisource transcription. Source HTML navigation and page-number anchors excluded; paragraph line-wrapping and HTML whitespace collapsed to spaces; invisible page-break markers removed. Wording, punctuation and paragraph boundaries retained. The library text holds the whole volume's three stories in printed order: Youth, Heart of Darkness (sections I to III) and The End of the Tether (sections I to XIV), each under its printed title and section numerals; the volume's front matter and the story half-titles are omitted. The row of eight asterisks that divides Youth is kept as one paragraph. A Wikisource editor’s signature found inside the transcription of Youth is removed (see acquisition).

rights.basis: The supplied English text is from the 1902 Blackwood edition, published before 1931 and in the US public domain as of 2026. The digitized volume identifies its publication year; no modern introduction or annotation is included.

acquisition.method: Wikisource rendered page HTML (index.php action=render) for twenty pages in printed order: Youth: a Narrative, and Two Other Stories/Youth, /Heart of Darkness and its /Section 1 to /Section 3, /The End of the Tether and its /Section 1 to /Section 14 (revisions 10698534, 16458211, 10698120, 10698223, 10698217, 10698221, 10698236, 10698257, 10698274, 10698306, 10698321, 10698344, 10698366, 10698377, 10698420, 10698443, 10698495, 10698494, 10698531, 10698569); downloadSha256 is the SHA-256 of the twenty responses concatenated in that order and downloadUrl the first of them. Only the transcluded scan text is used: Wikisource headers, page-number anchors and zero-width page-boundary characters removed (the transcription has no footnotes); half-title pages dropped; story titles and section numerals became headings; the asterisk line-separator table became one paragraph of spaced asterisks; paragraphs joined with whitespace and the transcription's hard line breaks collapsed; emphasis flattened. A Wikisource editor’s signature, “19Eliza (talk) 02:12, 3 December 2023 (UTC)”, left inside the transcluded text of Youth between “Bless the old woman.” and “She overhauled my outfit”, is removed (2026-11-18).
